artworks.title: James V, King of Scotland
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a person from the chest up, facing forward. The individual has a pointed beard and mustache, expressive eyes, and a composed expression. They wear an ornate hat with feather-like details and a jewel-decorated band. They don regal or ceremonial clothing with elaborate patterns and decorations, including a chain across the chest and circular emblem patches on the sleeves. The background features an oval frame on a plain surface with line shading. The text at the bottom identifies the person as "James V King of Scots" and the date "Ano 1514."

artworks.title: James I, as James VI of Scotland
artworks.description: This image shows an illustration of a person's head and upper torso. The person is depicted in a three-quarter turn to the left. They have a high forehead and are sporting a mustache and beard, with their hair neatly styled. The individual wears an ornate garment typical of the late Renaissance or early Baroque period, featuring a doublet and a ruff collar. The image is framed within an oval border containing Latin script. The background of the image is textured with parallel lines within the oval frame and natural paper outside it.

artworks.title: James I, as James VI of Scotland
artworks.description: This image depicts a man in a three-quarter view portrait from the chest up. He is facing slightly to his right, with his body turned towards the viewer's left. The man has a beard and mustache, accentuating his sharp facial features. He wears a wide-brimmed hat with a plume, a richly embroidered garment with a high collar, and a necklace with a visible medallion. The background includes an oval frame with inscribed text and decorative motifs in the corners outside the oval.

artworks.title: James I, as James VI of Scotland
artworks.description: The image depicts a man in three-quarter view, facing left. He has a slender face with pronounced cheekbones, a well-groomed mustache, and styled hair. The man wears a formal outfit with ornate details, including a high lace collar, a patterned doublet, a cloak, and a tall hat with a feather. He also wears a piece of jewelry. The portrait is in an oval frame with ornate designs and inscriptions. The background is dark.

artworks.title: James I, as James VI of Scotland
artworks.description: The image depicts a man in a three-quarter view position, facing slightly to the right. He has a mustache, styled back hair covered by a tall hat adorned with a feather and jewels. He wears a detailed doublet with a ruffled collar, and a richly detailed cloak. A medallion hangs around his neck on a chain. The background features an oval frame with text and decorative elements.

artworks.title: James I as James VI of Scotland
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of an individual from the chest up. The person is slightly turned to the right, with their face directed towards the viewer. They have a mustache and short hair that is curled at the front. The individual wears a tall, wide-brimmed hat with a feather, and elaborate formal clothing with intricate patterns and textures. Their attire includes a neck ruffle and embellishments. The background features an ornate oval frame with foliage and floral motifs. Surrounding the image within the frame is Latin text identifying the individual as "OREAD REX SERENISSIMUS IACOBVS VI". Additional script below the portrait suggests the individual is James VI of Scotland.

artworks.title: James I as James VI of Scotland
artworks.description: The image is an illustration of the upper body of a person seated and facing forward. The individual has a long pointed beard, a mustache, and a serious expression. He wears a tall hat with a decorative element, an ornate garment with a high ruff collar, and a fur-trimmed cloak. His hands are clasped together on a cushioned surface, with a ring on one finger. The background features a line pattern typical of engraved portraits, with some text visible horizontally and vertically on the page.

artworks.title: James I as James VI of Scotland
artworks.description: The image depicts a man from the waist up, seated with his hands resting on a cushion. He has a pointed beard, a mustache, and an elegant expression. He wears a tall hat with a brooch, a fur cloak, and a lace collar. His hands, wearing rings, are placed in front of him. There is Latin text above and below the portrait providing information about the person.

artworks.title: James I
artworks.description: The image shows a man's upper body in a three-quarter position, facing slightly to the right. He has a prominent forehead, arched eyebrows, a mustache, and a neatly trimmed goatee. His hair is neatly combed back and wavy. He is wearing a high-collared garment underneath a decorated breastplate. The portrait is enclosed within an oval frame with Latin inscriptions. The background is textured with horizontal lines. There is additional Latin text above and below the oval frame.

artworks.title: James VI, King of Scotland
artworks.artist: Pieter de Jode I after Adrian Vanson
artworks.description: The image shows an engraving of a man depicted from the waist upwards. He is positioned facing slightly to his left while gazing directly at the viewer. The man's facial features include a thin mustache and beard around his chin, with hair mostly covered by an elaborate hat. His hair appears short and curls slightly at the nape of his neck. He is wearing a richly detailed outfit, including a shirt with visible buttons up the front and a fur-trimmed cloak draped over his shoulders. A large, ornate hat crowns his head, featuring a feather and bejeweled band. In the background, to the right, there is a coat of arms topped with a crown. The background consists of a lined, nondescript pattern.

artworks.title: James VI, King of Scotland
artworks.artist: Pieter de Jode I after Adrian Vanson
artworks.description: This is a portrait of a man shown from the waist up. He is positioned facing forward but with his head slightly turned to the left. The man has a defined facial structure with a pointed beard and mustache. His hair appears to be light in color and is styled neatly beneath a tall, elaborately decorated hat, which features a jeweled band and plume. He is wearing a formal robe draped over his shoulders, lined with fur, and underneath he wears a buttoned garment with a high collar. There is no visible jewelry. The background consists of a pattern of horizontal lines. The man is accompanied by a crown and crest to his right. The text below the image indicates his identity and title.

artworks.title: James I and Anne of Denmark with GeneologicalTree
artworks.description: The image is an engraving showing two full-length portraits of a king and queen in an ornate architectural setting. The king is on the left, standing with one hand on a large armrest and holding a scepter. He wears royal attire, including a doublet, breeches, and a cloak. The queen stands on the right, holding a fan and possibly a scepter. She wears an elaborate gown with a lace collar and a fur-trimmed cloak. Both have crowns and the engravings include decorative elements like genealogical charts and coats of arms. The background features architectural details with columns, arches, and floral motifs.

artworks.title: James I of England
artworks.description: The image shows an engraved portrait of a man in a slightly turned position, facing forward. The man has a full face with distinct features, including a beard and mustache. He is wearing a wide-brimmed hat adorned with feathers and a ruffed collar around his neck. His clothing includes a fur-lined robe with ornate decorations. He wears a necklace with a pendant or medallion. The background is plain with an oval frame around the portrait. Below the image, there is text in Latin.

artworks.title: James I
artworks.description: This image shows a portrait of a man positioned front-facing within an oval frame. The man has a serious expression with distinct facial features, including a prominent nose and short beard and mustache. His light-colored hair is visible under his hat. He is wearing a large-brimmed hat with decorative elements, a fur-trimmed cloak, a high ruffled collar, and a round medallion on a chain around his neck. The background features parallel lines, Latin script, and graphical embellishments within the oval frame.

artworks.title: James I
artworks.description: The image depicts a man's upper body. He is facing the viewer and appears static. The man has an older look, a groomed beard and mustache, and medium-length hair under his hat. His facial features include deep-set eyes and a calm expression. He wears a wide-brimmed hat with feathers, fur-trimmed coat, and collared garment. Around his neck, there is a chain with a medallion. The background has a patterned border with the text "PACIFICI BE ATI" in an ornate font circling him. Additional text in the border below the portrait follows a traditional design for historical portraits.

artworks.title: James I on Horseback
artworks.description: The image depicts a man seated on a rearing horse, holding a scepter in his right hand. The man has a determined look, facing forward but slightly to the side. He has a prominent nose, a beard, medium-length wavy hair, and is dressed in royal attire with intricate designs. The horse is also adorned with ornamental tack. The background shows a cityscape with buildings, water, sailing ships, and a bridge. Above the scene is a crest with a detailed design and text.

artworks.title: James I
artworks.description: The image shows an engraved portrait of a man facing slightly to the right. He has a high forehead, a prominent nose, a goatee, and a mustache. He has curly brown hair, a wide-brimmed hat with plumes, a high collar, a detailed jacket with buttons, a chain around his neck with a pendant, and is set within a rectangular frame with inscriptions.

artworks.title: James I
artworks.description: The image shows an upper-body portrait of a man facing the viewer. He has a mustache and beard, a serious expression, and distinct facial features. He wears a hat with a feather, an elaborate outfit with a lace ruff, fur-trimmed robe, and a doublet with buttons. He also wears jewelry and holds a scepter in his right hand. The background features an oval frame with inscriptions along the border and detailed hatching within the frame.

artworks.title: James I
artworks.description: The image shows an upper-body portrait of a man facing slightly to the right. He has a long face with a full beard and a mustache. His hair is wavy and partly covered by a hat with a large plume. The man is dressed in an ornate outfit with a detailed ruff around his neck, an embroidered jacket, a sash hanging from one shoulder, and a pendant. He also wears a large brimmed hat with feathers and an ornate band. The background includes a decorated oval frame with inscriptions around it.

artworks.title: James I
artworks.description: The image depicts a portrait of a man from the chest upwards, facing forward with his head slightly turned to his right. The man has distinctive facial features, including a mustache and goatee. His hair is curly and styled to flow backwards. He is dressed in ornate armor with detailed patterns. There is a ribbon-like scroll surrounding the portrait with inscribed text. The background has a dark, cross-hatched pattern, with additional classical embellishments and text below the portrait.

artworks.title: James I
artworks.description: The image is a portrait engraving of a man facing slightly to the right. He has a broad mustache, neatly trimmed beard, wavy hair, and is wearing an ornate outfit from the early 17th century. The outfit features decorative patterns and elements suggesting high status. The portrait is within an oval frame with inscription along the edges and text below. The background is a simple textured surface.

artworks.title: James I
artworks.description: The image features a detailed engraving of a man's bust, shown from the shoulders up. The man faces slightly to his left, with his gaze forward. He has a defined facial structure, a mustache, and a beard. His hair is neatly combed and slightly wavy. He is wearing an ornate royal garment with intricate patterns and embellishments on the collar and fabric. The outfit includes a decorated doublet with designs on the shoulders, chest, and arms. The background has a textured, engraved pattern with an oval frame around the man. Text around the oval states his name and titles. Below, a French inscription in elegant script adds to the sophisticated presentation.

artworks.title: James I
artworks.description: This image is a portrait of a man facing slightly to his left. He appears to be sitting or standing in a formal pose. His facial features include a pointed chin beard and a neatly trimmed mustache. His hair is combed back from his forehead and cut short on the sides. He is dressed in an ornate outfit, likely a suit of armor, featuring intricate designs on the chest plate. He is also wearing a high-collared, ruffled shirt beneath the armor. Around his neck, there is a chain with a medallion. The background of the image is plain, and the portrait is surrounded by an oval border containing Latin text. The entire image has a monochromatic, engraved appearance, with detailed lines and shading.

artworks.title: James I
artworks.description: The image shows a man seated and turned slightly to the side, holding a scepter in one hand. He has a mustache, a small goatee, wavy hair, and is wearing a fur cloak and a decorative collar. The portrait is framed by an elaborate border with laurel leaves, ribbons, and ornamental designs. In the background, there is a detailed patterned curtain and an elaborate crown on a pillow. At the bottom, there is an inscription with a decorative coat of arms on the left side.
